Package org.smtlib.impl

Class SMTExpr

java.lang.Object
org.smtlib.impl.SMTExpr
All Implemented Interfaces:
IAttributeValue, IExpr, INode, IPos.IPosable, IResponse
public abstract class SMTExpr extends Object implements IExpr
This class defines a number of subclasses that implement the SMT-LIB abstract AST; they are used by commands and expressions.
